_comment: Commit Guardian — Legacy Template Configuration (templates/commit-guardian/). This directory is the legacy template location, superseded by templates/scripts/commit_guardian/. Maintained for hook parity checking only. Hooks registered here must also appear in the canonical manifest at templates/scripts/commit_guardian/commit_guardian.json.

hook_parity._comment: check_hook_parity.py — Parity enforcement across runtime dir, canonical template dir, legacy template dir, and deployed output dir. All paths are relative to the project root.

hooks_manifest._comment: Legacy manifest hooks array. Every hook ID here must also appear in the canonical manifest at templates/scripts/commit_guardian/commit_guardian.json. The parity check enforces this invariant on every commit.

hooks.name: Check Hook Parity (leafcutter)
hooks.description: Enforces parity of commit-guardian hook scripts and manifest entries across runtime, canonical template, legacy template, and deployed output dirs
hooks._comment: EPIC-Phase1ReadyHardening/04: Blocks commits when hook scripts or manifest entries are missing from any of the three tracked source dirs. Fail-open on I/O errors.
